name: Severity counter deep-links from the PR list into a filtered PR
description: Spec 002. The seeded PR #482 carries one CRITICAL ('Hardcoded Stripe secret key in commit') and one WARNING ('N+1 query in user list endpoint'), so its FINDINGS column reads ⊙1 ⚠1. Clicking the CRITICAL chip must land on the PR's Agent runs tab already filtered (?severity=CRITICAL) with the active-filter chip showing, and clearing it must bring the WARNING finding back. The negative half — that the WARNING is absent WHILE the filter is on — is asserted in the FindingsPanel unit test rather than here, because these flows only use locators that wait for presence. Read-only seeded data (no model call). Same seeded-repo assumption as flows 02/04/05 — run via the hermetic stack.
